entities.summary: Marieke Koekkoek is a Dutch lawyer and politician for the pro-European party Volt Netherlands. She was elected to the House of Representatives in the 2021 general election owing to the number of preference votes she received. She left the House in November 2025. Prior to being a member of parliament, she studied law and worked as a legal intern.
